summary: Flathead County, MT lookout: 40' L-4 tower dated 1934, 53' replacement in 1962, destroyed 1989; sources disagree on the first date and no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com's text gives 1934 for the 40-foot tower but its header gives 1935; the story and record use 1934 from the text

Forest Lookouts names the Flathead National Forest with the Northern Montana Forestry association; firelookout.com names the Flathead National Forest with Montana DNRC. Both name the Flathead National Forest, which is the value recorded
firelookout.com dates destruction to 1989; Forest Lookouts says only removed. The 1989 date is used

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' confirmed. Brief agency differs from firelookout.com (Montana DNRC); recorded as Flathead National Forest, which both sources name. height_m omitted because the lookout had two towers (40 ft, 53 ft). Access and visit left out: no source describes access. Staffing as_of 1952 is the last named lookout, not a closing date. Trails of the Past (foresthistory.org) mentions a Blacktail mining prospect, not this lookout; not used. The Blacktail Mountain Ski Area near Lakeside is a different business as far as the sources show; not used. Photo credit on firelookout.com (Barbara Boorman, Fire Lookout Museum) has no image URL in the fetched text; none added. Staffing and fire history is thin: no fires are named in either source.
